<!--
Explain what this step does and why, and copy each command you ran into a
bash chunk. R chunks run from the top of the repository.

Answer: This step uses MinPath to analyse the functional annotations of individual genes predicted by Prokka and infer broader metabolic pathways. This helps identify the potential metabolic capabilities of the assembled genome bins and explain the presence of those genes. 
-->

Metabolic pathways inferred from the Prokka annotations with MinPath. Commands for this step were run in `minpath/`.


Change directory to minpath folder:
```bash
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/minpath
```


Inputs for minpath prepared for each bin on the prokka .tsv file: Start by looking at a single bin:
```bash
head ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv
```


Input to minipath, transforming the tsv file using awk.
Inputs: unique ID (col 1) and EC number (col 5)
```bash
head ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv | awk -F '\t' '{print $1,$5}'
```


Use -F '\t' to tell awk the input is tab separated: require lines with EC number:
```bash
head ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{print $1,$5}'
```


Ensure output is tab separated: remove the header line:
```bash
head ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'
```


Replace head to cat to include all genes instead of the first 10:
```bash
cat ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'
```


Send output to a file to be used as input for minpath:
```bash
cat ../prokka/metabat.30/metabat.30.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus' > metabat.30.ec
```


Now run minpath on this file as follows;
```bash
minpath -ec metabat.30.ec -report metabat.30.ec.report -details metabat.30.ec.details
```


Take a look at the top few lines of output:
```bash
head metabat.30.ec.report 
```


Check prokka job: 
```bash
tail ../prokka/slurm-517.out
```


When prokka is done, prepare minipath inputs for all bins:
```bash 
while read bin;do 
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)}' | grep -v '^locus' > ${bin}.ec 
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

Run minpath on every bin:
```bash 
while read bin;do 
  minpath -ec ${bin}.ec -report ${bin}.ec.report -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

Search for PWY-101 (named photosynthesis light reaction) pathway across all the bins:PWY-101 Includes essential components for photosynthesis:
```bash 
grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report
```
